about: C3 public ownership API projection and diff. Killers run in process.

mutants.name: c3-implicit-take-marked-written
mutants.from: v.TakesInferred = len(takes) > 0 && f.Decl != nil && f.Decl.Type.Takes == nil
mutants.rule: The checker inserts Close's takes; the source did not write it.

mutants.name: c3-copy-site-omitted
mutants.rule: The docs and JSON retain the checker copy sites.

mutants.name: c3-new-copy-not-breaking
mutants.rule: A new copying parameter excludes resource callers.

mutants.name: c3-new-take-not-breaking
mutants.rule: A new take breaks a caller that still uses its resource.

mutants.name: c3-plain-change-resource-warning
mutants.rule: A plain-data change is not a new ownership restriction.
